title: P2P Lending Platform: Mexico deep edition

questions.q: In "Read your local market Understand", which of these is a key idea?
o: A large market with strong regional differences. Start in one city and one niche.
Price the platform fee and show the lender return after losses.
Keep marketing consent records; offer a clear way to stop messages.
Show proof of repayment history from the pilot, with plain risk numbers.

questions.q: In "Choose your sector Analyse", which of these is a key idea?
o: Cluster F, Food and farming: Strong fit: food and farming are central; check health-risk rules for food and alternative proteins. Check with a local expert.
Close to the northern trading partners: near-shoring creates demand for services, testing and training.
Issue electronic invoices as the tax rules require; learn the tool before the first customer. Check with a local expert.
Trust: tax ID, address, delivery days and a refund note on every page; consumer rules apply. Check with a local expert.

questions.q: In "Register and license Apply", which of these is a key idea?
o: Some activities need extra licences (food, health, tourism, money); list yours before the first order. Check with a local expert.
Write MXN next to every number.
Keep a list of every tool that stores customer data, including messaging apps.
Close to the northern trading partners: near-shoring creates demand for services, testing and training.

questions.q: In "Protect data and customers Apply", which of these is a key idea?
o: Local caution: A large country: start in one city, test one offer, then grow.
Break-even units = fixed monthly cost divided by contribution per unit; round up.
Keep a list of every tool that stores customer data, including messaging apps.
Assign roles: credit reviewer, partner contact, support; write a late-payment call script.

questions.q: In "Find and serve customers Create", which of these is a key idea?
o: Cluster B, Technology and digital services: Strong fit: near-shoring means firms need IT support, testing, security and cloud services in Spanish.
Contribution per unit = price minus the cost of each unit.
Add tax and duty explicitly; never bury them in a price. Check with a local expert.
Payments: bank transfer, cards and cash-payment points; show prices with the sales tax clearly. Check with a local expert.

questions.q: In "Price, tax and money Evaluate", which of these is a key idea?
o: Many customers use bank transfers, cash-payment points and cards; a lot of buying is on messaging apps.
Protect borrower and lender data; use identity checks via the partner and store the least data.
Check against a worse case: if sales are 25% lower, do you still cover costs?
List the lending licence, disclosure rules and collection rules; a licensed firm must run the money side. Check with a local expert.

questions.q: In "People and partners Apply", which of these is a key idea?
o: Issue electronic invoices as the tax rules require; learn the tool before the first customer. Check with a local expert.
Payments: bank transfer, cards and cash-payment points; show prices with the sales tax clearly. Check with a local expert.
Employers register staff for social security and pay the year-end bonus; budget both.
Channels: messaging apps, social media and marketplaces; local fairs and markets for a first test.

questions.q: In "Launch plan and review Create", which of these is a key idea?
o: One measure per week: enquiries, orders or revenue; pick one.
Compare three models: direct matching, pooled funds, partner bank referral. Pick by legal risk. Check with a local expert.
Protect borrower and lender data; use identity checks via the partner and store the least data.
Trust: tax ID, address, delivery days and a refund note on every page; consumer rules apply. Check with a local expert.
